document: Nawras Digital DMCC — Security Questionnaire Response
format: CAIQ v4 style self-assessment (structured for machine testing)
note: Responses marked with an assertion carry a named predicate that Bayyina can test against externally observable evidence. Responses without one are recorded but cannot be tested from outside.

responses.question: Are deprecated TLS versions (1.0 and 1.1) disabled on all Internet-facing services?
Is TLS 1.3 supported on Internet-facing services?
Is DMARC published and set to an enforcing policy (quarantine or reject) on your corporate domain?
Is SPF published with a hard-fail terminator on your corporate domain?
Is HTTP Strict Transport Security enforced with a max-age of at least one year?
Is a Content Security Policy enforced on customer-facing web applications?
Is DNSSEC enabled on your corporate DNS zone?
Are CAA records published to restrict which certificate authorities may issue for your domains?
Is MTA-STS published to prevent downgrade of inbound mail transport?
Do all session cookies carry the Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes?
Are software product and version identifiers suppressed in HTTP responses?
Do you publish a vulnerability disclosure contact and policy (RFC 9116)?
Have you been free of any publicly disclosed security incident in the last 36 months?
Have you been free of any security incident originating with one of your sub-processors?
Does the scope of your ISO/IEC 27001 certification cover the legal entity and services that would deliver this contract?
Are administrative and database services (RDP, SSH admin, SQL, Elasticsearch, etc.) prevented from being reachable from the public internet?
Are background verification checks carried out on all personnel with access to customer data?
Are cryptographic keys managed in a dedicated key management system with documented rotation?
Are backup restoration procedures tested at least annually with documented results?
Is a secure development lifecycle applied, including peer code review before release?
Is an independent penetration test performed at least annually by a third party?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for all privileged and remote administrative access?
Are security logs retained for at least 12 months and protected from modification?
Are data centre facilities protected by documented physical access controls?
Is a business continuity plan documented, with defined RTO and RPO, and exercised annually?
Is customer data stored and processed exclusively within the United Arab Emirates?
Are sub-processors subject to prior written approval and equivalent security obligations?
Is customer data encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent?
Are critical vulnerabilities remediated within 15 days of identification?
Do all personnel complete security awareness training on induction and annually?
